Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.

📜 About • 🕰️ Label History • 🏛️ Strategic Assets • 🔍 DSP Verification

Closed Submission Policy

Engine Room Records does not accept unsolicited demos, artist submissions, or representation inquiries. Any submissions received are automatically deleted before reaching any inbox.
